items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: Well I’ve never met Ken Burns, and I’ve played on three of his soundtracks.

ctx.x: Tell me about getting involved in the PBS thing with Ken Burns.
Well I’ve never met Ken Burns, and I’ve played on three of his soundtracks. I hear a lot about him, but I just know the people who do music for him.
You know he’s working on a jazz thing now.
